events.title: Group Prefixes
events.description: Omniscient implemented custom group prefixes for threads, giving group owners the option to select from a list of custom usergroup themes. The idea was suggested by -Scrub.

events.title: The Fallen Have Arrived
events.description: 7 (formerly NulldB) purchased the former group Revenge and rebranded it to Fallen, intending to focus on increasing content/activity and on blackhat content.

events.title: Group & Crew News
events.description: Neil is offering to lease his group to any approved member. Succubus and Marketers remain listed for sale. Revenge was purchased by 7. BlackCats, Cult, and Mafia crews remain listed for sale.

events.title: Posts, prestige, and reputation milestones
events.description: Sky received six awards. Migos reached 2,000 posts and 3,000 popularity. Sholi reached 2,000 posts.

events.title: Bans
events.description: 49 bans for the month, 46 of which were permanent. source was banned for harassing members.

events.title: Account closures
events.description: funtela was closed for open disputes. Raymond Reddington was closed for open disputes but reopened shortly after.

events.title: Hackúman Season 2 Ending
events.description: Omniscient announced the end of Hackúman Season 2 on August 1st and the start of Season 3, with discussion about new incentives to engage crews and members.

events.title: Bytes for Profit
events.description: Neil is offering buy-ins to his custom usergroup Profit at 1,000 bytes per entry, granting membership and access to its private subforum.

events.title: HF News Support Contest Winner
events.description: Evading won the July HF News Support Signature drawing.
